description: Sarah approaches Carlos directly about the RoboRide price drop to $0.12/mile and residential expansion. She frames it as a professional assessment conversation, not anxiety-venting: What is his read on the shop's 2-3 year trajectory? Has management's posture shifted this week? What are EV fleet operators actually looking for in certified techs beyond the Level 1 credential itself? She shares her own analysis — that the residential expansion changes the adoption curve in a way the 7% usage figure does not yet reflect, and that this compresses the timeline for when EVT credentials become essential versus merely advantageous.

information_exchanged.sent: Sarah's analysis of RoboRide residential expansion as an adoption curve inflection, not a linear continuation. Her read that auto sector volume decline will accelerate. Her intent to push EVT completion to 4-5 months rather than 6.
information_exchanged.requested: Carlos's current read on shop management posture post-announcement. Any line on EV fleet operator hiring criteria beyond Level 1 cert. Whether he has heard anything from Patricia about staffing considerations.

relationship_effect.note: Continued professional collaboration and information sharing between trusted colleagues navigating the same structural disruption.
